The '''Pral system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Pral system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" /> Although the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' placed Pral within the Jahilid Drift, which was stated to be an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region,<ref name="CSWE" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the Pral system in grid square L-21 as part of Wild Space instead.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Jason Fry confirmed during the development of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] that the Wild Space localization prevails.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_2.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-04-06}}</ref>
